<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak, a +1 Da peak at ~12 % (indicative of ^13C), and a +2 Da peak at ~33 % (characteristic of the ^37Cl/^35Cl natural abundance ratio)—the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
